criterion_text: Repeated/double Enter, stale generation, blocked launch, missing kernel privilege, Agent restart or detached client cannot leave a falsely active Sandbox or orphan owned resources; failure preserves original Pane and reports error; Return to Native changes focus without silently killing the Sandbox Pane; actual shell exit cleans up the owned isolated Pane.

verifiers.summary: Repeated, stale, blocked and exiting Sandbox transitions fail closed without false state or orphaned resources

evidence.value: a duplicate delivery of enter_id sc04-enter-5410 replayed execution 4c2955ff-2e59-4776-bf52-368d6869b525 and created no second Pane
a pre-Enter generation with a new attempt id was refused as conflict while the context stayed inside
a blocked launch left the Native Pane active, created no Pane and wrote no record
a detached/reconnected client still observed the same durable execution
Return to Native kept the Sandbox Pane alive; focus returned inside without a new Enter
the sandboxed shell exit removed the Pane and its durable record within the reaper window
